summary: Iteration 45 — Direct-WS Trade Execution for 21s Reversal strategy. Validated POST /api/po/trade/ws-execute error paths (no SSID / fake SSID / invalid direction / pydantic 422 validation / amount gt 0), GET /api/po/trade/ws-status structure, Mongo audit to po_ws_trades collection, _normalize_asset helper (5 variants), and Tampermonkey v8.11.0 modular bundle markers (po/trade/ws-execute, po/ssid/status, executionMode, bridgeHealth, version 8.11.0). All 16 backend tests PASSED. Real PO WS not reachable in test env — all failure paths return success:false with clean error strings and latency_ms (no crashes/5xx).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pocket_option.py is now 3059 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Should be split into sub-modules (legacy endpoints vs. new bridge/ws endpoints vs. selenium/headless). Not blocking but maintenance risk.

pocket_option_ws_executor: module-level globals (_client, _current_session, _client_lock) make unit testing harder and break in multi-worker uvicorn setups. Consider an app-scoped singleton attached to FastAPI state.
_get_or_create_client: on liveness-check failure the previous client is disconnected but errors from disconnect() are swallowed silently — OK for now; add a debug log.

po_ws_trades audit writes both the raw `direction` (req.direction.upper()) and the original `asset` (not the normalized form). The `place_trade` return uses normalized asset but only for the response — consider storing both for traceability.
No rate-limiting / deduplication on /api/po/trade/ws-execute — a misbehaving script could spam trades. Add an idempotency key or per-session cooldown.

Bundle markers '21s-reversal-ws' / '21s-reversal-dom' listed in the review request are not literal strings in the minified bundle; the actual indicators present are `executionMode`, `bridgeHealth`, and endpoint refs. The _audited_ mode tag in response payload is `useWs ? 'ws' : 'dom'` — this is fine but the review checklist phrasing was ambiguous.
test_credentials: Not used — endpoints are unauthenticated for trade bridge.
seed_data_creation: Test temporarily inserts a fake session into po_ssid_state for WS-handshake-failure test and cleans up. Audit writes to po_ws_trades were cleaned at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 45 fully green. New endpoints /api/po/trade/ws-execute and /api/po/trade/ws-status are live. The WS executor (pocket_option_ws_executor.py) uses module-level globals for client caching — tests reset these via direct import. Mongo collection `po_ws_trades` is the audit log; `po_ssid_state` holds the bridged session. Bundle is v8.11.0 and contains all functional markers. To extend: when a real SSID is available, add a happy-path test that places a minimum-stake trade and checks response contains order_id + success:true + status:'placed'.
